articulation.label: rest
articulation.alt: rest: /r/ → /ɛ/ → /s/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /r/: Bunch the tongue; leave space at the ridge.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Read and write
sections: Puck has pain in his back after carrying heavy bags. He stops work to rest and lies down for a short time. Heart sends a message: “Get well soon.” The next day, he feels better but not completely well. He asks the clinic for advice before lifting more bags.
Is Puck completely well the next day? What does he do before lifting more bags?
Write two sentences using two words from today’s new word bank.
